title: Drug response from CCLE gene expression (PRISM Repurposing)

prism_auc.note: PRISM Repurposing secondary screen (Corsello et al. 2020): dose-response AUC of the 200 most variable, well-covered drugs on ~480 cancer cell lines; predict from baseline CCLE expression (DepMap 24Q4, ~19k protein-coding genes). Metric: mean per-drug Pearson r on held-out cell lines. Published held-out-cell-line baselines: median per-drug r ~0.40 on GDSC (Carli 2025); few PRISM non-oncology drugs exceed 0.4.
